## Primary Commercial Experience: Deepixel
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer (April 2026 – Present)
- **Flagship Platform**: Invictus — Enterprise AI Deal Intelligence and Reporting Platform
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Engineered an interactive AI report workspace with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming progress, user clarification prompts, timeout recovery, and saved deal context.
  - Built a responsive mobile application shell with bottom navigation and Progressive Web App (PWA) setup, resolving standalone session persistence.
  - Stabilized rich document editing by resolving Tiptap table state overwrites, nested-table parsing, and export pipelines.
  - Designed automated DPI display scaling algorithms for Windows 125% and 150% environments, enhancing screen usability on dense displays.
  - Audited 21 critical views across four viewport tiers using automated Playwright test suites, shipping 17 report-flow utility test modules.
  - Supported local microservices with Docker orchestration, health-check scripts, and API routing.

## Featured Projects & Technical Case Studies
- [Invictus (Deepixel)](https://msameerali.dev/#experience): Enterprise AI deal intelligence platform with SSE streaming reports, Tiptap document editors, and Playwright verification. Tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Tiptap, Laravel, SSE, Playwright.
- [WordWanderer](https://msameerali.dev/projects/wordwanderer): Gamified language-learning platform with spaced repetition (SRS), lesson progression loops, streaks, and pronunciation feedback. Tech: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Zustand, MongoDB, Express.js. Live demo: [wordwanderer.vercel.app](https://wordwanderer.vercel.app).
- [OptiTrade 3.0](https://msameerali.dev/projects/optitrade): High-frequency stock market and portfolio tracking dashboard with sub-15ms calculations, watchlists, and JWT authorization. Tech: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, TanStack Query. Live demo: [opti-trade-3-0.vercel.app](https://opti-trade-3-0.vercel.app/).
- [InvoiceGen Pro](https://msameerali.dev/projects/invoicegen-pro): AI-assisted business invoicing suite integrating Gemini AI automation, Stripe payments, and automated PDF invoice generation. Tech: Next.js 15, Gemini AI, MongoDB, Stripe. Live demo: [invoicegen-pro.netlify.app](https://invoicegen-pro.netlify.app/).
- [PhotoStream / SnapCloud](https://msameerali.dev/projects/photostream-snapcloud): Cloud-native photo-sharing platform featuring dual client architectures backed by an asynchronous FastAPI microservice and MongoDB Atlas. Tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, FastAPI, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary. Live demo: [portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net](https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net).
- [SAMIO](https://msameerali.dev/projects/samio): Local-first personal finance and life-operations dashboard with OTP authentication, signed sessions, and relational database integrity. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL. Live demo: [portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:8443/login](https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:8443/login).
- [Peshawar Civic GIS Atlas](https://msameerali.dev/projects/peshawar-civic-gis-atlas): Open civic GIS platform with Leaflet mapping, facility discovery, dataset validation pipelines, and RBAC publishing workflows. Tech: Laravel, PHP, Leaflet, MariaDB. Live demo: [portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:10000](https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:10000).
